title: 第6章 老丑记忆觉醒杀人坏婚礼第5章 龙战二凤月娥悲鸣美奴功法齐丰收
content_zh:
老丑一路施展轻功，迅捷而归，踏着清晨第一缕阳光返回。
仙宫内一切平静。老丑不敢大意。
此番下山不仅得了功法还收了一个美奴，虽寻不得仇万离，但也有意外之喜。
此刻白小楼人头在手，正好邀功，刚去汇报。却不曾想被拒在门外。不得入见苏若雪当面。
只得到守备主管转达的淡淡一句。知道了。
老丑只能作罢，心中愤恨不已。好大的架子！
回到杂役院又一番打坐。
终于在采补吸收了萧月娥纯正元阴后，混元无极功突破第一层。
老丑心中大喜，却不曾想下一刻，脑海中猛地一炸。
那些画面像碎玻璃扎进来。
大殿。金椅。年轻的手搭在扶手上，下面黑压压跪了一片美奴。
那人非是旁人，正是他自己！
“不——！““李乾坤。“他嘴唇发抖，“我是李乾坤，我才是这锁仙宫真正的主人！“此刻异界来人和原身终是融为了一体。也告原身浑浑噩噩四十年生活结束！
---今日，宫内忙碌许多，下人来来往往，张灯结彩。
“主人要成亲了，跟陈至尊成亲，宫内上下都在准备呢。““成亲？“老丑脚步顿住。
“陈逸风。“此刻他已恢复了全部神智，“陈安之子！父债子偿，就从夺走你儿子的女人开始。““老子绝不会让你们如愿成婚！“阴冷地笑着。
晚上又巩固了玄功，悟得第一层奥术——混元一气掌。信心大增。伴随着更多玄力凝于丹田后浴火烧得更猛了几分。低头看了一眼裤裆：“得尽快泄火！“是夜，老丑起身去找萧月娥。出宫时，见两个身影往山下而去。
是二等护卫。大晚上行动，看来必有要事。
他偷偷尾随到山脚，趁着二人不备，两记混元一气掌击出。其中一人临死前欲捏碎什么，老丑眼疾手快匕首斩落手腕。两人随之毙命。
截获的信件展开——请帖。是苏若雪与陈逸风成婚请帖，送往玄天各大宗门。

“混蛋。“他狠狠骂了一声，转身赶往萧月娥藏身之处。
路上夜风一吹，他浑身燥热。想着那个被他压在身下的女人，脚步不由加快了几分。
萧月娥见他回来，身体微微一颤，连忙跪下：“主人……”
老丑没有多话，从怀中取出一粒药丸，递到她面前：“吃了它。”她跪在地上，衣领微敞，露出一截白腻。老丑盯着看了两眼，喉结滚动，把药丸塞进她嘴里时，指尖故意在她喉咙里插了一下。
content_en:
Lao Chou performed Qing Kung along the way and returned quickly, returning with the first ray of sunshine in the morning.
All is peaceful in Asgard. Lao Chou dare not be careless.
This time when I went down the mountain, I not only got the skills but also took in a beautiful slave. Although I couldn't find revenge for Wanli, I also had unexpected joy.
At this moment, Bai Xiaolou had his head in hand, so he wanted to take credit and just went to report. But I never wanted to be shut out. You are not allowed to see Su Ruoxue in person.
He only received a faint sentence conveyed by the defense supervisor. knew.
Lao Chou could only give up, feeling filled with resentment. What a big rack!
I returned to the courtyard and meditated again.
Finally, after taking supplements and absorbing Xiao Yue'e's pure Yuanyin, Hunyuan Wuji Gong broke through the first level.
Lao Chou was overjoyed, but he never thought about the next moment when his mind suddenly exploded.
Those images penetrated like broken glass.
Main hall. Golden chair. The young man's hands were resting on the armrest, and there was a mass of beautiful slaves kneeling underneath.
That person was none other than himself!
"No -!" "Li Qiankun." His lips trembled, "I am Li Qiankun, and I am the real master of this locked fairy palace!" At this moment, the alien and the original body finally merged into one. He also told me that his life of forty years of confusion was over!
---Today, the palace is very busy, with servants coming and going, and lanterns and festoons being decorated.
"The master is getting married. He is getting married to Chen Zhizun. Everyone in the palace is preparing." "Getting married?" Lao Chou paused.
"Chen Yifeng." At this moment, he had regained all his consciousness, "Son of Chen An! The father's debt must be paid by the son, starting from the woman who took your son away." "I will never let you get married as you wish!" smiled coldly.
In the evening, I consolidated my profound skills and understood the first level of arcana - Hunyuan Qi Palm. Confidence increased. As more profound energy condensed in Dantian, the fire burned even more intensely. He lowered his head and glanced at his crotch: "We have to vent our anger as soon as possible!" It was night, and Lao Chou got up to look for Xiao Yuee. When leaving the palace, I saw two figures walking down the mountain.
He is a second-class guard. It seems that there must be something important going on at night.
He secretly followed them to the foot of the mountain, and when the two were unprepared, he struck out two Hunyuan Qi palms. One of them wanted to crush something before he died, but the old man cut off his wrist with a dagger with quick eyes and quick hands. Both men died subsequently.
The intercepted letter unfolds—an invitation. This is an invitation for the wedding of Su Ruoxue and Chen Yifeng, sent to all the major sects in Xuantian.
"Asshole." He cursed fiercely, turned around and rushed to Xiao Yue'e's hiding place.
The night wind blew on the road, making him feel hot all over. Thinking of the woman pressed beneath him, he couldn't help but speed up his steps.
When Xiao Yue'e saw him coming back, her body trembled slightly and she quickly knelt down: "Master..."
The old man didn't say much. He took out a pill from his arms and handed it to her: "Take it." She knelt on the ground, with her collar slightly open, revealing a section of her white skin. Lao Chou stared at it twice, his Adam's apple rolling, and when he stuffed the pill into her mouth, he deliberately dug his fingertips into her throat.
